ideas.pitch: Real-time visualization tool for competitive programming knockout matches showing memory, execution traces, and submission race conditions.
ideas.title: Codeforces Algorithmic Duel Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since this hackathon is specifically an offline competitive programming contest and knockout tournament on Codeforces organised by PYC Club, a tool that enhances the live spectator and debugging experience for knockout matches directly serves the event's core focus.

ideas.pitch: Personalized machine learning recommendation engine that analyzes a Codeforces handle's submission history and suggests optimal upsolving problems.
ideas.title: CP Upsolve Recommender
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the competitive programmers participating in Syntax Sprint by using algorithmic data analysis on Codeforces stats to improve rating growth.

ideas.pitch: Lightweight terminal-based local testing environment that simulates Codeforces time and memory limits with instant local grading for multiple languages.
ideas.title: Submitspeed Offline Testing Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a concrete workflow pain point for contestants racing against the clock in an offline 3-hour competitive coding environment.

ideas.pitch: Offline-first leaderboard and performance tracking dashboard for monitoring the Syntax Sprint live contest standings and participant stats.
ideas.title: CP Streak & Rating Tracker Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate utility for event organizers and participants tracking the knockout matches and live rankings.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered tool that parses complex Codeforces problem editorials and breaks them down into intuitive algorithmic intuition steps and pseudocode.
ideas.title: Codeforces Editorial Summarizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly helps participants learn faster during post-contest upsolving by transforming dense editorial text into clear visual logic.
